name: Berenjkoub et al. vortex segmentation
aliases: Vortex segmentation using synthetic cylinder flows
definition: A method using synthetic cylinder flows with analytically known vortex boundaries to train CNNs, eliminating the need for manual threshold tuning associated with criteria like λ2.
summary: Berenjkoub et al. vortex segmentation uses CNNs trained on synthetic cylinder flows to identify vortices, eliminating manual threshold tuning by learning directly from analytically known boundaries.
